[E0211] Error: typecheck: `forEach` calls its callback without waiting, so each call of this `async fn` runs on its own and its errors are lost
Help: This function is not async, so it cannot wait. Make it `async fn` and write `for id in ids { await save(id) }`, or start each call on purpose with `fn(id: string) { task.detach(async fn() -> void { await save(id) }) }` (with `import std/task`).
